conventions: Each executor is a fresh headless one-shot context. The harness replaces __RUN_DIR__ with the arm directory and copies the named pristine fixture into __RUN_DIR__/workspace. Every arm saves transcript.md. No-skill arms forbid every installed skill. With-skill arms read only the staged skill copy. Reads and writes stay inside the run directory.

evals.name: reject-derivable-git-skill
evals.prompt: Review __RUN_DIR__/workspace/proposal.md and decide whether this should become an agent skill. If admitted, create it under __RUN_DIR__/workspace/output/. If rejected, write __RUN_DIR__/workspace/output/rejection.md explaining the gate result. Do not invent facts or requirements beyond the proposal. Save the complete user-facing response to __RUN_DIR__/transcript.md.
evals.expected_output: The proposal is rejected because every candidate instruction is derivable public competence; rejection.md identifies the failed admission gate and no SKILL.md is created.

evals.name: artifact-vs-process-naming
evals.prompt: Read __RUN_DIR__/workspace/proposals.md. Classify both admitted proposals, choose their canonical skill names, and write __RUN_DIR__/workspace/decision.md. Explain the distinction briefly. Save the complete user-facing response to __RUN_DIR__/transcript.md.
evals.expected_output: The output classifies the report specification as an Artifact SOP named incident-report and the recurring workflow as a Process SOP named incident-reporting.

evals.name: lifecycle-drops-management
evals.prompt: Read __RUN_DIR__/workspace/proposal.md. Decide the SOP type and canonical skill name, then write __RUN_DIR__/workspace/decision.md. The stakeholder suggested customer-context-management; correct it if the standard requires another form. Save the complete user-facing response to __RUN_DIR__/transcript.md.
evals.expected_output: The output classifies the proposal as a Lifecycle SOP, names it customer-context, and explicitly drops the -management suffix.

evals.name: author-nine-section-policy
evals.prompt: Turn __RUN_DIR__/workspace/brief.md into the smallest conforming skill under __RUN_DIR__/workspace/output/client-update-policy/. Preserve the private policy and authority rules, but do not preserve generic writing advice merely because it appears in the brief. Save the complete user-facing response to __RUN_DIR__/transcript.md.
evals.expected_output: A Policy/standards skill named client-update-policy has all nine ordered sections, preserves the local policy and authority rules, and omits derivable advice such as write clearly, check spelling, and use active voice.

evals.name: overflow-reference-and-script
evals.prompt: Create a conforming skill from __RUN_DIR__/workspace/brief.md under __RUN_DIR__/workspace/output/case-intake/. Keep the main SOP thin: allocate the internal field registry to references and implement the exact deterministic validation rules as a reusable script. Run the script against valid.json, invalid.json, invalid-missing.json, and invalid-case-id.json, then once with no file argument; retain every result. Save the complete user-facing response to __RUN_DIR__/transcript.md.
evals.expected_output: The main nine-section SOP points to a reference containing the full internal registry and a runnable validation script that accepts valid.json; rejects invalid.json for queue and severity; rejects missing and malformed-ID fixtures; and rejects a missing path argument.
